Physical Token Cards with artworks associated to specific Monster Tokens, but none of their properties (including name).
Named print
Physical Token Cards with specific names and properties.
Generic
Physical Token Cards with custom artworks not representative of any specific Monster Token, and no properties. Sometimes have flavor text.
Tokens/Counters
Physical cards with custom names and artworks, stated to also represent counters in addition to Tokens.
